item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has used naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya's Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO's chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports of a planned nuclear satellite, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli air strikes have killed senior Hamas security officials in Gaza, while Israeli forces have cut $90 million from border community recovery budgets to fund defense and detained a Polish lawmaker ahead of a West Bank visit. Gaza health officials have issued an alert over a rising meningitis epidemic, and a night of arson has been linked to Israeli Jewish terrorism. Israel's top court described West Bank settlers as acting like militias, and the United Nations warned that the war has undone 77 years of human development in Gaza. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Israeli artillery and airstrikes continue targeting southern Lebanese towns such as Wadi Zibqin and other border communities, while Hezbollah maintains its fire and expands its arsenal, including reported shipments and activity in Yemen. The Israeli government has redirected $90 million from border community recovery budgets to defense and is delaying completion of the Lebanon border wall, while US sanctions on Hezbollah affiliates are seen as having limited impact. Iranian forces are reported to be developing chemical weapons, and Iran’s Revolutionary Guards have been ordered to leave Beirut strongholds, indicating a shift in regional involvement. Civilian areas and health facilities in Lebanon remain under attack, and UN peacekeepers are surrounded by devastation. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces launched missiles from Saada toward Aden, with projectiles reaching Dhamar and a strike on a civilian vehicle in Lahj that killed a child and injured three others, while a Houthi drone was intercepted by the Saudi-led coalition in the Red Sea. The coalition also intercepted another Houthi drone and a missile in western Yemen and hit a Houthi arms depot east of Taiz. The UK imposed sanctions on the Houthi group and four senior officials. Saudi air strikes killed 17 people in a Yemeni city. There were 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:
US officials are weighing a military training and demining mission for Syrian forces while a budget shortfall threatens the chemical weapons watchdog’s ability to continue work in Syria. Israeli forces raided southern Syria, wounding Syrian soldiers, and a drone strike in western Sweida injured four Syrian internal security personnel. In Damascus countryside two Christian young men were found dead, and in Homs a church robbery led to the arrest of suspects including a guard. A son of a Daesh leader was killed in Homs and a mortar attack killed one civilian and injured three in Syria. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
The Iraqi prime minister has ordered the ministry to take direct control of oilfields in areas held by Kurdish parties, prompting the KDP and PUK to unite in opposition and warn Baghdad against unilateral decisions. Security forces have dismissed the border crossings chief and a border official, installed new commanders in Kirkuk, and seized trucks in a fuel smuggling operation. Iraqi security also seized two drone launchers in Maysan and reported a drone hit an Azadi camp minutes after a missile strike. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Drone strikes have hit a United Nations building and residential areas in Khartoum, killing four people and threatening humanitarian operations, while RSF forces have assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. New defections include the RSF counterintelligence chief, a commander and a group joining the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties within the conflict. Ethiopia has offered to host inclusive Sudan peace talks and proposes a national unity government. The war produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Ethiopia has offered to host comprehensive Sudanese dialogue and Abiy Ahmed has called for Sudanese parties to join a mediation table, while leaked intelligence suggests Eritrean and Sudanese coordination of drone strikes on Mekelle and Assosa. Ethiopian forces have regained control of border areas near Badme, and fighting along the Afar-Somali border continues over territorial disputes, drought and resource scarcity. Amnesty International has called for a probe into possible war crimes in Tigray, and 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Federal forces have relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy while the defence minister reported killing nearly 285 al-Shabaab fighters, including 12 leaders, in Bay, Shabelle and Hiiraan. The United States conducted airstrikes on three al-Shabaab sites in Somalia. President Museveni of Uganda met Somalia's president to discuss regional security and the AU peacekeeping transition, and the Ugandan army chief visited Somali troops amid a withdrawal from Barawe. Somalia warned that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken security operations involving the African Union mission. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
